simple.meaning: בָּרַד (bârad) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to hail.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 32:19. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּרַד (H1258) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בָּרַד (bârad) / H1258 is traced through Isaiah 32:19 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H1258. barad בָּרַד verb denominative hail , הַיָּ֑עַר בְּרֶדֶת וּבָרַד consecutive Isa 32:19 it shall hail .
